subject: science
passage: Many reef-building corals reproduce in a single burst each year, releasing bundles of eggs and sperm into the water over just a few nights. The timing is not ______ typically follows the full moon by several days, and within that window, colonies of the same species tend to release their bundles during the same hour or two after sunset, a synchrony that greatly increases the chance that eggs and sperm from different colonies will meet.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

explanation.why: "The timing is not random" is an independent clause, and what follows, "spawning typically follows the full moon by several days, and ... colonies ... tend to release their bundles ...," is also independent and explains why the timing is not random. A colon can join two independent clauses when the second explains the first.
explanation.A: Incorrect. A comma alone can't join the two independent clauses; this is a comma splice.
explanation.B: Incorrect. "Rather" is an adverb, not a conjunction, so setting it off with commas still leaves two independent clauses joined only by commas, which is a comma splice.
explanation.C: Correct. The colon joins the two independent clauses, and the second one explains what the nonrandom timing looks like.
explanation.D: Incorrect. A "which" clause must have a gap that "which" fills, but "spawning typically follows the full moon" is already complete, so "which" has no role and the sentence is ungrammatical.
